description: Get team packages. These are packages sent by MASV team users directly to MASV. It does not include packages sent to Portals. To get full list of packages you need to get both team packages and portal packages

created_at_end.description: Retrieve records that were created before (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:SS)

created_at_start.description: Retrieve records that were created after (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:SS)

extra_storage.description: If true, will only include packages which will or have already incurred extended storage costs

limit.description: Number of records returned per page

page.description: Page number of paginated response. First page is 1

status.description: Select packages with status. New - package is currently uploading and not ready for view/download yet, finalized - package was uploaded and is ready for download, view, or transfer to another storage destination, expired and archived means that package was deleted and files are not available anymore

tags.description: Filter packages by tag id. If any of provided tag ids match package will be returned

teamspaces.description: Retrieve records where teamspace id is equal to one of these values

name: get_packages
title: List team packages
